description: Java class TreeUriDownloader extending Downloader, handling file downloads from Android Storage Access Framework using document URIs, with methods for input stream retrieval, size calculation, and download control.

classes.name: TreeUriDownloader
classes.description: A subclass of Downloader for downloading files from Android Storage Access Framework URIs, with custom input stream handling and size estimation.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Retrieves an InputStream for the given URI, converting specific exceptions to NotFoundException or ProtocolException.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Indicates whether the file has changed; currently always returns true.

methods.name: totalDownloadSize
methods.description: Returns total size of the download, either from index file or document file length.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Initiates the download process by streaming data.
